Dynamic simulation

Select a saved Case to run it.

Add and save at least two valid equipment units before running a simulation.
At 1×, one virtual second takes one real second. When an equipment unit includes an accumulationZone, capacity is derived from usable length and product pitch, product travels at the configured conveyor speed, Prime requests downstream start, and Back-up requests an upstream stop. Legacy buffers remain abstract.

Engine boundary

The browser engine executes the deterministic Case. Apps Script is responsible for identity and Drive persistence; Gemini is not used for calculation. Sensor positions in the public demo are transparent synthetic assumptions, not a PLC or safety-control design.
